purpose: Prospective expansion of R8 archive search and relative-power injection/recovery calibration. No discovery claim.
selection: First four distinct eligible target names in fixed order, metadata-only identical Parkes fine S/R/S cadence rule as R8; prefer dates MJD >=58575 within each target. No intensity selection. R8 and original groups excluded.
drift_grid: integer total channel displacement across complete scan

calibration.method: For each actual OFF tile, two fixed seeded positions and slopes; test original subtile for baseline coincidence, add one-channel signal in raw power scaled by per-row MAD*1.4826, re-normalize and run the exact R8 top-five blind search; paired same background and track at every amplitude. Recover when start/end within 2 channels. Record all attempts including baseline coincidence; no threshold tuning.
calibration.scope: Algorithm sensitivity on sampled OFF subtiles, not absolute flux/SEFD calibration or survey-wide false-alarm probability. Correlated paired trials, descriptive fractions only.

claims: No calibrated astronomical detection or independent new observation. Archive reanalysis only; negative results bounded to selected tiles and threshold.
